report_name: SonicWall: Attacks on US SLED Sector Up 242%

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used to exploit the Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) vulnerability in public-facing government systems by sending a specially crafted string to a vulnerable Java-based application, leading to unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2021-44228
vulnerabilities.description: The Log4Shell vulnerability in Java-based applications was responsible for 19.5 million attack attempts against U.S. SLED organizations, highlighting significant failures in patch management.

identities.name: U.S. state, local, and education (SLED) organizations
identities.description: A sector in the United States that experienced a 242% increase in cyberattacks in the first half of 2026, targeted due to underfunded IT, legacy systems, and inconsistent patch management.

indicators.name: Log4Shell JNDI Injection Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Log4Shell JNDI Injection Attempt
id: 2f8a9e10-9c3b-4d7e-8a1b-6f5c4d3e2a1b
status: experimental
description: Detects JNDI injection strings in web server logs, which are indicative of Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) exploitation attempts.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sonicwall-research-finds-state-local-and-education-sled-cyber-attacks-surge-242-in-first-half-of-2026-302913725.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-20
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - cve.2021.44228
level: critical
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri-query|contains:
      - 'jndi:ldap://'
      - 'jndi:rmi://'
      - 'jndi:dns://'
    c-user-agent|contains:
      - 'jndi:ldap://'
      - 'jndi:rmi://'
      - 'jndi:dns://'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects JNDI injection strings in web server logs (URI query or User-Agent), which are indicative of Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) exploitation attempts.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process from Java Application
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process from Java Application
id: 8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-7e8f-9a0b1c2d3e4f
status: experimental
description: Detects the Java process spawning a command shell, a common post-exploitation behavior following a successful Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) attack.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sonicwall-research-finds-state-local-and-education-sled-cyber-attacks-surge-242-in-first-half-of-2026-302913725.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-20
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - cve.2021.44228
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '/java'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects the Java process spawning a command shell, a common post-exploitation behavior following a successful Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) attack.
